Compound Channel Segment.description: Compound Channel Segment (power-law main channel + floodplain)
Compound Channel Segment.helptext: Channel segment with a power-law main channel, A = channel_coeff*y^channel_exponent for depth y <= bank_depth (exponent 1 = rectangle, 2 = triangle/parabola-like), and above bank_depth vertical channel walls plus a floodplain of flat width floodplain_width and side slope floodplain_side_slope. Wetted perimeter: main channel P = T(y) + 2y with top width T = channel_coeff*channel_exponent*y^(channel_exponent-1); above bank the floodplain bottom (ramped in over the first 0.1 m) and sloped sides are added. A pool_depth (dead storage below the zero-flow control) can be set: Storage and depth include it, the flowing area exposed as 'area' excludes it, and obs_depth = depth - pool_depth. Depth is obtained from Storage by inverting the area relation in closed form. Exposes area, perimeter, head, ManningCoeff and length, so it connects with the existing channel links (Trapezoidal_Channel_link, channel2fixed, Reach_link, groundwater_to_stream, pond outlets). Implementation note: all state-dependent quantities are written inline in terms of Storage (depth) and depth (area, perimeter, top width) only; chains of named helper expressions were found to be evaluated with stale values. Requires the Expression::argument_values fix for _min/_max with two compound arguments.

channel_coeff.warningmessage: Channel area coefficient must be greater than zero
channel_coeff.helptext: Coefficient a of the main-channel area-depth relation A = a*y^m (SI: m^(2-m)).

channel_exponent.warningmessage: Channel area exponent must be at least 1
channel_exponent.helptext: Exponent m of the main-channel area-depth relation; 1 = rectangular, 2 = triangular.

bank_depth.description: Bank-full (maximum) depth of the main channel
bank_depth.warningmessage: Bank depth must be greater than zero

floodplain_width.description: Floodplain flat width (in addition to the main-channel top width)

floodplain_side_slope.warningmessage: Floodplain side slope must be greater than zero

pool_depth.description: Pool (dead-storage) depth below the zero-flow control
pool_depth.helptext: Depth of water retained at zero flow (pool behind the riffle/control). Storage and depth include the pool; the flowing area used by the connectors excludes it. Must not exceed bank_depth.

ManningCoeff.warningmessage: Manning's roughness must be greater than zero

length.warningmessage: Length must be greater than zero

bank_width.description: Main-channel top width at bank-full depth

depth.helptext: Depth of water above the channel invert (main channel + floodplain). The value entered is the initial water depth; the initial storage is computed from it with the compound section. If depth is initially unknown, it is estimated based on storage.

xsectionarea.helptext: Cross-sectional flow area. (Called 'area' before Oct 2026; 'area' is now the water-surface area, as on other blocks.)

area.helptext: Plan area of the free water surface (segment length x top width). Used by surface processes such as atmospheric (re)aeration and precipitation.

velocity.helptext: Mean of the velocities of the channel links connected to this segment (.v = average over links). Used by the reaeration models.

total_area.description: Total cross-sectional area including the pool

obs_depth.description: Depth above the zero-flow control (comparable to gage height minus gage height of zero flow)

Compound_Channel_link.description: Link from a compound channel segment to another channel segment
Compound_Channel_link.helptext: Manning (diffusive-wave) connector between channel segments; identical to Trapezoidal_Channel_link (upwind flowing area, average wetted perimeter and roughness). Works with Compound Channel Segment and Trapezoidal Channel Segment.
